component.name: Heliograph
component.summary: A fast, private library and player for your pictures, videos and music

description.p: Heliograph browses and plays very large media collections without slowing your computer down. It loads only what is on your screen, reads details in the background only when the PC is calm, and keeps everything in a local database on your own machine.

ul.li: Open any folder or file, or keep folders in a library with a timeline, favourites and search
Plays formats browsers cannot, such as MOV, MKV, HEVC and ProRes, using hardware acceleration when available
Recognises hundreds of picture, video and audio formats, including camera RAW and HEIC
Converts pictures, video and audio with FFmpeg, and never changes your originals
Private: nothing leaves your computer, and there is no telemetry
Can be used by AI assistants through a built-in, read-only MCP server
